exceptions.crowdsec: Agent reads host log files using hostPath mounts.
exceptions.democratic-csi: Storage drivers require privileged containers, host networking and host device mounts.
exceptions.games: Steam Sunshine requires host ports; other applications inherit this namespace exception until it is isolated.
exceptions.infra: Node exporter uses host networking/PID/mounts; short-lived node-maintenance jobs require privilege.
exceptions.kube-system: CNI/service load-balancers, storage and device plugins require host access.
exceptions.kubevirt: Virtualization node handlers require privilege, host PID and device mounts.
exceptions.media: Gluetun requires NET_ADMIN for the qBittorrent VPN. Jellyfin writable media is preserved.
exceptions.minecraft: Claude bridge uses a hostPath mount.
exceptions.talaria: In-progress isolated restore init requires DAC_READ_SEARCH; Elasticsearch IPC_LOCK removed. Application admission guard constrains this remaining capability.
